text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Knowing destiny,
yet striving to transcend 
it. People call that—possibility.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for this year's final 
match! Forget about who conquered the 
world first,
let's see who's the strongest 
right now!
